parts.text: A student investigates the refraction of light by a transparent block. He uses his results to determine a quantity known as the refractive index of the material of the block. The student’s ray-trace sheet is shown full size in Fig. 3.1.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The student places a transparent block ABCD near the centre of the ray-trace sheet, as indicated in Fig. 3.1.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Draw a normal at point N , extending above AB . Label the upper end of the normal with the letter L . Extend the normal downwards until it crosses line CD . Label the point at which it crosses CD with the letter F . [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The student draws line EN as shown in Fig. 3.1. On Fig. 3.1, measure the angle θ 1 between the lines LN and EN . θ 1 = ..................................................... [1]

ms.label: 3(b)
ms.text:
not suitable
should be as far apart as possible

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The student views the images of P 1 and P 2 through the block. He places two pins, P 3 and P 4 , so that pins P 3 and P 4 , and the images of P 1 and P 2 , all appear exactly one behind the other. • Draw a line through P 3 and P 4 , extending the line until it meets NF . • Label the point at which this line meets NF with the letter G . • Label the point at which this line crosses CD with the letter H . • Draw a line joining points N and H . [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate a value n for the refractive index, using the equation n = a b . n = ..................................................... [2]

ms.label: 3(d)(ii)
ms.text:
n = 1.4(1)
expressed to 2/3 significant figures and no unit

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) The student repeats the above procedure for an angle θ 2 = 40°. He places two pins, P 5 and P 6 , so that pins P 5 and P 6 , and the images of P 1 and P 2 , all appear exactly one behind the other. • Draw a line through pins P 5 and P 6 . Extend the line until it meets GH . • Label the point at which this line meets GH with the letter K . • Label the point at which this line crosses CD with the letter R .

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Measure the angle α , where α is the smaller angle between lines RK and GH . α = ..................................................... [1]

ms.label: 3(e)(ii)
ms.text: statement matching results and justification matching statement (‘within limits of experimental accuracy’ / owtte)

ms.label: 3(f)
ms.text:
any suitable precaution e.g.
look at base of pins/keep pins vertical
use thin pins
thin lines

ms.label: 3(g)
ms.text:
any one of:
difficult to align pins/place pins accurately
pins (too) thick
lines too thick
